proof_body:
by
  intro p hp
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := IsCyclic.exists_generator (α := (ZMod p)ˣ)
  refine ⟨(g : ZMod p).val, ZMod.val_coe_unit_coprime g, ?_⟩
  rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val, orderOf_units, orderOf_eq_card_of_forall_mem_zpowers hg, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ZMod.card_units]
target_source: ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → ∃ g : ℕ, Nat.Coprime g p ∧ orderOf (g : ZMod p) = p - 1
